page_title: OSA 1-0 SEV | Osasuna v Sevilla 24/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Adrian Cordero is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' It is time for a substitution. Kike Barja (Osasuna) is on for Ruben Garcia.
87' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Adrian Cordero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Sergio Herrera.
87' Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
86' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Sevilla win a corner.
86' The attendance is 20555.
85' Osasuna exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) is replacing Ante Budimir.
82' 2:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
78' Substitution. Djibril Sow did his best and is replaced by Suso (Sevilla).
78' Here is a change. Jose Angel Carmona is going off and Joaquin Caparros Camino gives the last tactical orders to Peque (Sevilla).
78' What was Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

76' A short pass finds Aimar Oroz (Osasuna). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
75' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post.
74' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
71' Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

70' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.

67' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sevilla are going to take it.
66' Substitution. Abel Bretones leaves the pitch and is replaced by Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
64' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

62' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
62' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) prepares to take a corner kick.
61' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Sevilla will take a corner kick.
59' Osasuna take a short corner kick.

58' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
56' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Osasuna.
51' A quickly taken corner by Osasuna.

50' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Osasuna force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
49' A cross into the box from Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is cleared.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) is replaced by Iker Munoz.
46' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Bryan Zaragoza comes on the pitch for Alejandro Catena (Osasuna).
46' The whistle blows and Adrian Cordero starts the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Osasuna are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
45+2' Confusion here but it seems that referee Adrian Cordero has changed his mind following the VAR review and downgraded the red card shown to Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) to a yellow.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.

45' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna), but referee Adrian Cordero must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
45' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
44' Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Adrian Cordero signals a set piece.
41' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
38' Joaquin Caparros Camino decides to make a substitution. Diego Hormigo Iturralde will be replaced by Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla).
37' The Osasuna players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
33' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
30' The possession of the ball – 49:51.
28' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
25' 1 - 0 Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) scores a goal from the resulting free kick, sending it into the top right corner. What a strike that is, absolutely fantastic!
24' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) attempts to release Ante Budimir with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
19' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) commits a foul during an attacking move.
17' Osasuna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) is penalised for a foul. Adrian Cordero had a clear view and blows his whistle.
12' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
9' The linesman signals that Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

6' Diego Hormigo Iturralde (Sevilla) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.

5' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Sevilla are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
2' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Osasuna will take the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
